Fill in the publication of a journal's own works that OpenAlex cannot place

Source: R/utils_preprocess_register.R
add_journal_venue_issn.Rd

The publication normally comes from the work's OpenAlex record and never from the register's `Venue` column, because a conference venue spans several publications over the years. A journal is the exception: a check of type `journal` is of a work submitted to that journal, so the venue *is* the publication. Lifecycle Journal is the case this exists for: CrossRef registers its articles as posted content without an ISSN, so OpenAlex has no source for them and the works got no "published in" statement (codecheckers/register#50).

Usage

add_journal_venue_issn(register_table, venues)

Arguments

register_table

The register table, with `Type`, `Venue`, `OpenAlex`, `Paper ISSN` and `Paper venue` columns

venues

The venues table from `venues.csv`, with `name`, `longname` and `identifiers`; `NULL` leaves the table unchanged

Value

The register table, with `Paper ISSN` and `Paper venue` filled in from the venue where that applies

Details

Only a work OpenAlex knows but cannot place - an OpenAlex ID, and neither an ISSN nor a source name - is filled in. A work whose record names a source, such as a preprint server, keeps what OpenAlex says.
